Application chrome

Controls, fields, and metadata at working UI scale. Every surface here is a flat plane with a 1px rule — there is no shadow anywhere in this system. Switch data-strata-palette to spectrum or data-strata-theme to dark on the <html> element; nothing on this page changes.

Buttons

Tab through the row to see the focus ring

The ring is outline plus outline-offset: 2px, never a shadow. The offset is load-bearing: it keeps the ring off the fill so its contrast never depends on which button it lands on.

Fields

Status badges

Each badge is bordered in its own ink. A bare tint field measures around 1.1:1 against the page and two bare tints can be identical in luminance, so the border is what makes the badge a perceivable object rather than differently coloured text.
